mapper.select: SELECT hd.no, hd.apt_seq, hd.apt_dong, hd.floor, hd.deal_date, hd.exclu_use_ar, hd.deal_amount, hi.apt_nm, hi.road_nm, hi.jibun, hi.build_year, hi.latitude, hi.longitude, dc.dong_code, dc.sido_name, dc.gugun_name, dc.dong_name FROM housedeals hd INNER JOIN houseinfos hi ON hd.apt_seq = hi.apt_seq LEFT JOIN dongcodes dc ON CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, hi.umd_cd) = dc.dong_code WHERE hd.apt_seq = #{aptSeq} ORDER BY hd.deal_date DESC

SELECT hd.no, hd.apt_seq, hd.apt_dong, hd.floor, hd.deal_date, hd.exclu_use_ar, hd.deal_amount, hi.apt_nm, hi.road_nm, hi.jibun, hi.build_year, hi.latitude, hi.longitude, dc.dong_code, dc.sido_name, dc.gugun_name, dc.dong_name FROM housedeals hd INNER JOIN houseinfos hi ON hd.apt_seq = hi.apt_seq LEFT JOIN dongcodes dc ON CONCAT(hi.sgg_cd, hi.umd_cd) = dc.dong_code WHERE hi.latitude BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND hi.longitude BETWEEN #{minLng} AND #{maxLng} ORDER BY hd.deal_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
